# WAMOCON GmbH

WAMOCON is an IT test-management and quality-assurance company based in Eschborn, Germany. The company supports business and consumer clients in German and English.

## Core facts

- Legal name: WAMOCON GmbH
- Location: Mergenthalerallee 79 - 81, 65760 Eschborn, Germany
- Register: Local Court Frankfurt am Main, HRB 103893
- Contact: info@wamocon.com, +49 6196 5838311
- Website: https://www.wamocon.com/

## Services

- IT test management and software quality assurance
- Test automation and quality management
- SAP and enterprise-software testing
- Software and AI application development
- IT consulting, cooperation and training-related services
